Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation and appreciate the clarity on Elara's current architecture and compliance needs. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment:

- Primary requirement: PHI flows from EHR ingestion and clinician notes into our platform for extraction. HIPAA applies; Elara needs a signed BAA and controls to support audits.
- Preferred deployment: private VPC or on-prem was mentioned due to data residency and audit controls, but you asked about Dedicated (reserved capacity) as an intermediate option.
- Evidence requested: SOC 2 Type 2 report, encryption-at-rest details, key management options, and a list of audit logs we expose.

Next steps I propose:
1) I will send our latest SOC 2 Type 2 report and a BAA draft for your legal/security review. (attached for initial review)
2) Can you confirm the top 3 audit controls you need visibility on (e.g., access logs, admin activity, data retention)? That will help us map Dedicated vs Private implications.
3) If Elara is leaning Private VPC/on-prem, let's schedule a follow-up technical call with our infra lead (Dylan) to scope network requirements and timelines.

Timing: if you can confirm the controls list by EOD Thursday (9/23) we can route the BAA to legal and book a technical follow-up early next week.

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Deployment follow-up & next steps (Elara) — tech call request

Marissa —

I can take the technical call on Thu 9/24 at 10:00 AM PT. I'll invite our infra architect and have a short deck ready that covers: 
- Dedicated (reserved capacity) overview: identical runtime but shared network boundary with logical controls, quicker onboarding (2-4 weeks), limited customization on KMS (we host keys or customer-managed via our KMS integrations).
- Private VPC: isolated network, customer VPC peering or PrivateLink, customer-managed egress rules, recommended for PHI; longer onboarding (4-8 weeks) and requires network engineering coordination on both sides.
- On-prem option: support available but scope depends on their infra; likely 3-6 months.
- Logging and audit mapping: where admin access logs and API audit trails live, retention options (we can retain 24mo + export to their SIEM), redaction patterns for PHI in payloads, and HSM/KMS integration notes.

I'll also pull the SOC2 sections that map to their bullets and have them highlighted in the deck.

See you Thu.

—Dylan
